issues.description: The template Lecture class provides a constructor with only three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents), but the problem statement UML and the solution expect a constructor that initializes five attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). This mismatch in constructor parameters can confuse students about the required constructor signature and may cause tests or expected usage to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the constructor in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java in the template to match the UML and solution: add the missing parameters int numberOfLecturers and int numberOfTutors (in that order) and initialize all five attributes. Alternatively, remove the incomplete 3-parameter constructor and provide the full 5-parameter constructor: Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors).
